$comment: Copy to household.json, fill in, then: npm run setup:household -- household.json --accounts. Everything here can be changed in the app afterwards. Roles: admin (parents), family_carer (grandparents, relatives), home_carer (staff), sitter (babysitter: the child's log, the chat and the helper only). Presence: lives_here, staying_with_us, visiting_today, away. Work days: 0 = Sunday. hidden_modules hides whole sections for everyone (normally none). Members match by id (every run prints each member's id; put it in the file to make the row stable), else by e-mail, else by name. A member linked to a sign-in account keeps it: to move them to a new e-mail add "relink": true. A deactivated member comes back only with "active": true; "active": false deactivates. Members in the home but not in this file are listed and left alone unless household.deactivate_missing is true. The parent whose work hours drive the handover and the fridge plan is the one marked breastfeeds when she has work days, else a parent with work days and hours; on a day only one of them works, that one. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, times HH:MM; a field left "" is not set.
